notes.title: Patch 6 - The Big One!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/faad5de2e1659baff56e6db8c97980d77b5e2c2b.png[/img]

Fellow Survivors,

We’re excited to reveal our latest content update for Serum, this adds more of the road map content we revealed during the early access launch. Patch 6 is quite possibly our biggest update so far, and brings a lot of new player focused enhancements, and brought about some fixes that should iron out those performance issues some players were encountering. Tackling optimisation fixes was a much larger task than we first anticipated since it meant really getting under the hood of he game.

In addition to the new content, and performance tweaks, we’ve also been able to implement lots of other fixes to the game as well, and these addressed areas such as item storage, Inventory, missing localized text, UI and visual elements which should also make a big difference.

In patch 6 we’ve added Steam achievements and there are 23 to obtain in Serum. These achievements include various tasks such as finding the Pilot, defeating the formidable Alpha Wolf, recycling 100 items to gain valuable components, collecting all available files in the archive, and utilizing the Absorber 30 times among many others to obtain.

Based on player feedback you’ll be pleased to know that the Player difficulty level can now be customised giving you the option to adjust the level of challenge you’d prefer.
Included in this latest content patch are Combat traps providing you with even more tactical options against the creatures that roam Serums dangerous world.

Lastly, we’ve also added additional language support in addition to the 9 languages the game currently supports,

Let us know what you think of the update in our [url=https://discord.gg/fvuWbPMb66]Discord channel[/url].

Also, be sure to check out our latest Serum game stream on Serum’s official steam page where we go over all the recent updates including the new freestanding absorbers, trap placement function, achievements and the new combat traps.

notes.title: Survive or Die Fighting: Revealing the Lethal Realities of Combat
notes.content:
In the devastated world of Serum, mutated monstrosities lurk in the darkness, and death is only one false step away. Mutated beasts and even plants that have been infected by the Blight will hunger for your flesh to kill or injure you. Arm yourself with our combat essential guide to keep you safe.
 
Prepare yourselves for the inevitable combat that lays ahead as we reveal the combat essentials to your survival:
 
[h3]COMBAT ESSENTIALS GUIDE[/h3]
 
The test of a true survivor is their ability to handle threats, in Serum you’re going to come up against many different kinds, all hell bent on your untimely demise. Here’s some combat essentials to keep you safe.
 
[b]Choose wisely[/b] – Use the right type of weapon against certain adversaries, the bow is great at creating distance between you and danger, but a machete blade deals a hefty blow up close.
 
[b]Upgrade[/b] – Utilise serum and components to upgrade your weapons as soon as you can, things like serum enhanced arrows can make a real difference in combat.
 
[b]Timing [/b]– Tentarats spit a toxic substance, so time your attacks carefully before they can muster up another dose to fire at you.
 
[b]Combine weapons[/b] – Use your bow to initiate a first blood strike at distance before using melee weapons to finish the kill up close.
 
[b]Spear it [/b]– The spear has been trusted for centuries, it will also serve you well in Serum as a mid-range weapon to use, especially against Fog wolves.
 
[b]Use Cover[/b] – Cars, barricades and trees can provide essential cover from line-of-sight attackers, use cover to avoid confrontation or as a protective barrier from danger.
 
[b]Beware of pack animals [/b]– Pick your fights carefully, some mutated creatures attack in packs, getting overwhelmed you’re as good as dead.
 
[b]Tread lightly [/b]– Craft Serum blends to enhance abilities that can provide essential boosts, a silent stalking ability to reduce noise for example can be a lifesaver.
 
[b]Night vision [/b]– Create a serum brew that lets you see in the dark, get the advantage in low light situations.
 
[b]Block and Dodge[/b] – Utilise your melee weapons to block and dodge lethal attacks to stay in the fight longer. Look for patterns in the attack to defend against and time your blocks.

notes.title: Serum Early Access Roadmap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/006664a23ca74b86f3879db240e5f40269c35bbb.png[/img]

[h3]Fellow Survivors,[/h3]

Today, we wanted to share the content and features still to come for [b]Serum[/b] since we know that timely updates, fixes, and implementing community feedback are important to you, the player.

By far, the biggest decision has been to give co-op more time in development and integrate this later than planned within the early access window. While this may be disappointing to many of you, we feel it’s very important we can deliver updates and game content that live up to players' expectations because sacrificing the quality of the game is something we very much want to avoid.

The Serum roadmap below highlights the continued work going into Serum in the weeks and months ahead, leading up to the Version 1.0 release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/d28f10a112e2560371656faf496a6e1ec66adcd1.png[/img]

[b]Quality of Life Fixes[/b]

First and foremost, our focus is to implement a range of quality-of-life improvements for players as one of our first tasks on Serum. This includes [b]bug fixes[/b] and [b]additional languages[/b] and translations, and we’ll continually look at player feedback to implement these so that the player experience in Serum is optimised.

As our early access journey gets underway next on our list will be [b]achievements[/b] as we know that rewarding player interactions and milestones is important. We’ll also be looking to implement a [b]UI revamp[/b] to ensure that it’s consistently intuitive for players as they brew, craft and upgrade in the game.

Further down the road, the roadmap also plans on introducing new combat options with [b]combat traps[/b] allowing players to expand their arsenal of weapons with passive capability to trap adversaries in the game world.

[b]New Biome[/b]

Canyon will be the third biome for players to explore in addition to ground zero (the node), the forest area and the swamp maps that are currently available. Canyon will introduce some new challenging adversaries and a new level boss creature to defeat as part of the game's narrative. This is a dry, arid location that will challenge the player with additional side quests to seek out survivors and reveal much more about the mutagen storyline.

[b]Co-op mode[/b]

Co-op mode for up to 4 players gives survivors an opportunity to tackle Serum’s infected denizens as a team with friends. Player resources will be shared, and by working together, players can create their own strategies to maximize their effectiveness in the Serum world.

Of course, early access will see our ongoing work to balance the game, add new features, tweak existing ones, and optimize the overall game. Community feedback is still important, so do talk to us via Discord. We are listening.

notes.title: Serum Available Now on Steam Early Access!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/d4e84c721478de4308c21a0e31776c6251816a31.png[/img]

[b]Game Island[/b] in partnership with [b]Toplitz Productions[/b] are pleased to announce that our single player and co-op immersive story-driven survival adventure game [b]Serum[/b] is now available for PC via [b]Steam Early Access[/b].

Serum throws the player head first into a dark and intriguing narrative driven by a unique game mechanic: the mysterious elixir (serum) is essential to survival, a lifeline to be injected regularly as momentary respite. Players will discover how this vital liquid can prolong their existence, amplify their abilities, and enhance their makeshift arsenal of weaponry as they uncover the Serum conspiracy.

Underpinning Serum’s thrilling narrative is the game's unique crafting mechanics, players will need to explore the shattered world, hunting and setting traps in order to harvest sources of Serum to create essential recipes, each granting distinct skills and abilities crucial for overcoming the diverse array of mutated enemies that lurk in the hazardous environment.

Will you source your next dose in time? The clock is ticking, and time is also an ever-present adversary.

Join the conversation on our Discord channel and be sure to follow our regular diaries and game updates on social media. Check in tomorrow here on Steam for our [b]Serum game Giveaway[/b] starting at [b]7pm CET[/b] too!

[h3]Five Essential Things to Know About Serum[/h3]

[b]The Blight's Menace:[/b] Uncover the dark tale of Serum's narrative, where the Blight has ravaged the world, leaving chaos in its wake. Learn about the catastrophic event and the desperate need for a cure.

[b]Hope in a Vial:[/b] Serum is not merely a plot device; it is a lifeline. Discover how this vital liquid can prolong your existence, amplify your abilities, and enhance your arsenal. But beware, time is of the essence, and the clock is ticking.

[b]Adam's Odyssey:[/b] Assume the role of Adam, a daring Serum tester employed by EVAS. Dive into the challenges of testing potent Serum varieties, navigating a perilous world teeming with mutated monstrosities.

[b]Crafting and Survival:[/b] Engage in a battle for survival where crafting weapons and traps is essential. Brew various Serum recipes, each granting distinct skills crucial for overcoming the diverse array of enemies that lurk in the hazardous environment.

[b]Weapons & Abilities:[/b] Different weapons will be required for certain adversaries, What works on one enemy may not be as effective on others, adjust your tactical strategy and utilise powerful Serum abilities to help you overcome those who seek to do you harm.

Don't miss the chance to provide crucial feedback on Serum; we eagerly await your insights. Join the discussion on our Discord, delve into more Serum insights, and follow our Serum Diary on social media for exclusive updates.

Also, don't forget to check out the Serum Ultimate Edition which includes a Serum story codex, Serum cocktail recipe book and Serum official guide and the Serum Official Guide Edition which comes with the Serum official guide packed with expert insights and strategies.

notes.title: Questions and Answers: Round 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/6f85cfe783d1e88de384d679e3f7b8bb8f4d722a.png[/img]

[h3]Fellow Survivors,[/h3]

We are pleased to reveal the answers for our second questions and answers session for [b]Serum[/b]. We received many great questions from the community, and here is our pick of the best ones. Also, don’t forget to register for a chance to access the forthcoming [b]Serum Playtest[/b] here on Steam.

[b]Compared to the Next Fest demo the current Serum brewing UI looks different, has that changed?[/b]

We looked at the player feedback from the Steam Next Fest demo, and it was evident that we needed to improve how intuitive the crafting and brewing system was to use. We also wanted to make it easier to understand, so we’ve improved that aspect with a new format and layout, which players can explore in the forthcoming playtest.

[b]Where is the story of Serum set in terms of its location?[/b]

The story is set on a remote island known for its potent source of life-saving liquid, which is the key ingredient for serum. It's also where the EVAS Corporation set up its main base of operations and started its research to enhance the cure of Blight.

[b]How important are resources, is player progression tied directly to the brewing and crafting of Serum, do I need to craft and brew Serum?[/b]

The story hints at how important it is to utilize different resources found in the game world to survive, and we want players to explore and seek out those resources as they play. This includes organic material found in things like plants and animals that, when combined with other things found discarded in the world like batteries, nails, scrap metal, welding Electrodes etc, they all play a part in enhancing and upgrading your abilities and equipment, including upgrades to your base facilities. The serum brewing mechanic plays a big part in your survival and progression.

[b]How many different abilities based around Serum brewing will be possible?[/b]

The game's development extends beyond the initial Early Access release, so there’s no definite number of abilities at this point. We can only say that we already have a decent number ready, and all of them will be useful in both combat and exploration. We are always open to more suggestions from our players, and we will definitely consider adding more abilities based on player feedback.

[b]Why does the player character need to inject Serum to survive in the wilderness if animals don't rely on it to survive?[/b]

Like any other person in the game world, the character needs to inject Serum to counter the effects of The Blight. The animals and other enemies in Serum mutated due to the experimentation on Serum variants conducted by EVAS Corporation; hence, the substance has already altered their DNA, and they no longer require it. They have become a completely new species adapted to survive in the harsh post-apocalyptic environment.

[b]I noticed cable cars in the demo, can players transit between biomes using them?[/b]

We’re not going to spoil that for players, but let’s just say it's well worth investigating when you play the game.

[b]How would you position Serum, is it biopunk or sci-fi?[/b]

Serumis definitely inspired by science fiction in relation to its themes. The story is set in the future but has aspects that still keep it quite relevant and grounded, so it still has that appeal and familiarity. Serum could be classed as a kind of Biopunk story, given that the story hints at the implications of biotechnology, not to mention the mutated creatures you’ll encounter.

[b]Are there any plans for a beta version?[/b]

We have just announced a playtest starting on April 24th which will last for a whole week. We're keen for players to test and help us with constructive feedback and insights for early access. If you missed the chance to play the Steam Next Fest demo, then the Serum playtest is a great opportunity to try the game and tell us what you think.

notes.title: We're answering your questions!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/3691a2461c5d949caca40e55ab5a9ab9915fceb9.png[/img]

Thank you for your interest and questions about [b]Serum[/b]. We were inundated with so many to be able to answer them all, but here are answers to some of the more popular ones.

[b]How will melee combat function? [/b]
The combat in Serum is based around melee and range attacks. The players will be able to craft multiple weapons and choose the best one to face various enemies who are susceptible to different types of damage. Each melee weapon will have a basic attack and a strong attack. As the players progress through the game, they will be able to upgrade the previously crafted weapons and repair them.

[b]Will there be the option to target lock and block?[/b]
There will be an option to block the attacks, but to ensure a free flow of combat, there will be no target lock.

[b]Will there be a story-driven DLC that emphasizes hardcore gameplay within the sci-fi (horror) world?[/b]
Serum is a story-driven game from the start. There may be further expansions that will enhance the experience by adding additional content, but it’s still too early to say.

[b]Is there a mode that's not cooperative-based, without an excessive focus on crafting, base-building, and extensive customization?[/b]
As a story-driven survival game, the game is focused on crafting and brewing mechanics that are tied to the player’s progress throughout the story. Various assets and adversaries in the game are designed to encourage the players to be resourceful and explore the game word.

[b]Is it possible to sign up for the closed beta/alpha tests?[/b]
Not at the moment, but if the opportunity arises, we will make sure to let our community know about it. Please join our Discord and check for regular updates on our Steam page for further development news.

[b]In which engine is Serum produced?[/b]
Serum was initially developed in Unreal Engine 4, but we’ve decided that the best course of action will be to transpose the game to the latest version of the engine. Now, the game can be enjoyed using the latest technologies delivered by the power of Unreal Engine 5.

[b]What is the backstory of Serum?[/b]
The events in Serum take place in the near future, where the world as we know has been struck by a catastrophic event called The Blight. Due to the sickness caused by the event, the world’s population dwindled close to extinction. The only cure for the effects of The Blight is the mysterious Serum that the EVAS corporation used to develop the remedy.

[b]What is the Serum’s function in the game world?[/b]
Serum is the only cure for the effects of The Blight known to mankind. Depending on the type of sickness, people may require more potent variants of the remedy. After some time, it was discovered that extensive use of the Serum can cause suspicious mutations in living beings. Our story begins after a failed experiment to stop the effects of the mutation.

[b]When and where is the game set?[/b]
The game is set on an island where the main ingredient of the cure was initially discovered and where the EVAS corporation placed its base of operations in the year 2060.

[b]Will it come to consoles?
[/b]At this moment, our focus is on the Early Access version for PCs. We do, however, wish the game to be released on more platforms in the future.

[b]Will there be multiple difficulty settings?[/b]
The game will have only one difficulty setting that is tailored to suit more advanced and beginning players who are familiar with the survival genre.

[b]Is Serum compatible with Steam Deck?[/b]
At this moment, the game is not optimised to work with Steam Deck, but this may change before the planned release of the game in Early Access.

[b]How many different formulas of Serum can be created for players to utilize and benefit from?[/b]
We don’t want to spoil too much, but the ingredients for Serum can be gathered from many sources, and there will be a variety of formulas that the players can experiment with. Each one of those will come with its own set of benefits.

[b]How will co-op work in Serum, do players work together, and is there a different goal to the main story if playing in co-op?[/b]
The host of the co-op game will be playing as the main character of the story and have the same goals as if this were a single-player mode. The other players that join him will take on the roles of other survivors who join the player on his journey and work together to finish his task.

[b]Is there a Serum that extends the amount of time until you need to take your next dose?[/b]
The Serum brewed from the formulas discovered by the players can have various effects and extend the time needed before the next dose by a different amount of time.

notes.title: Fight to the death
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/a6e849f98369d498675a29ebc9cba3b919358c42.png[/img]

[i]On one of my latest excursions, I stumbled across a boar in a grotesque form that sent shivers down my spine. Its flesh was torn, exposing raw muscle, while its eyes glowed a haunting green. I knew that if I didn't fight, this beast would surely overpower me. 

As the creature charged towards me, I dodged its swipes, narrowly avoiding its razor-sharp tusks. Its strength was immense, and each blow felt like a sledgehammer against my body. I needed an advantage, something to level the playing field.

With a quick decision, I reached into my pack and retrieved a vial containing a mixture of [b]Serum[/b]. I injected it into my arm, feeling an immediate surge of power. My senses sharpened, my muscles tightened, and a newfound confidence coursed through my veins. I leaped towards the boar, my movements faster and more precise than ever before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/e5296bc143267decff9bcaf9084c96bbd204a648.png[/img]

With a series of calculated strikes, I managed to land blows on the boar, exploiting its weaknesses. The [b]Serum[/b] coursing through me heightened my reflexes, allowing me to dodge its attacks with ease. The fight raged on, and I could feel the strain on my body, but I refused to give up.

Summoning every ounce of strength, I launched a final, devastating attack. With a precise strike, I plunged my spear into the boar's exposed flank, piercing through its decaying flesh. The creature let out a loud shriek, and its body convulsed before collapsing to the ground.

I stood there, breathing heavily, my body covered in sweat and dirt. The fight had taken its toll on me, but I had emerged victorious. The Serum mixture had given me the edge I needed to defeat the mutated boar, but what will be the cost?

As I took a moment to recover, I kept thinking about other horrors this island could hold. Would I be able to survive the next encounter? Only time would tell. But for now, my victory over this beast was a testament to my will to survive in this unforgiving world of Serum-infested nightmares.[/i]

notes.title: This device should help me endure
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/1123c8eadad086aaef132d393d357143c0f3ef34.png[/img]

[i]It wasn't long after I found myself stranded in this strange place before I stumbled upon the plans for a [b]Growing Table[/b]. Building this device would allow me access to a sustainable source of [b]Serum[/b] from plants already growing on this island. I had to make it my top priority to craft one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/94a27bebbf8c2ebd45d3998a92ec4e583f01298e.png[/img]

In my short time here, I’ve learned that [b]Serum[/b] running through the plants was essential for survival on the island. The flora doesn’t offer much in quantity of the substance, but with enough plants, I can get ready for excursions deeper into the unknown.

Growing the plants turned out to be an easy task, but In the long run, I needed a more reliable source. The [b]Growing Table[/b] lamps consume a lot of power, and that is a scarce resource in this forsaken place. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/e78276591c3e6fbc506366d720fda7db8ac8606c.png[/img]

As I continued to explore the island, I encountered more and more strange creatures, all affected by the [b]Serum[/b] – most of them hostile. But no matter what, I knew the [b]Growing Table[/b] was only a short-term solution. If I wanted more Serum, I had to get ready to fight for it.[/i]

notes.title: I have found something more sinister than I could ever imagine
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/1e42352c12beefd17e248fc374649ad4815eb3f7.png[/img]

[i]As I wandered through the lush forest in search of resources, something caught my eye in the distance. A [b]dilapidated building[/b] with broken windows and an overgrown exterior stood out among the trees. Again, my curiosity got the best of me, and I decided to investigate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/590ecb4963d613c22b2c1883fab9fe7565e474d9.png[/img]

When I approached the building, a sense of unease washed over me. The front door was open, and I cautiously pushed it, stepping inside. The air was musty, and the only light came from the sun peeking through the cracks in the walls.

After my eyes adjusted to the darkness, I began to make out strange equipment scattered throughout the rooms. Tables with straps and restraints, jars filled with [b]unidentifiable liquids[/b], and medical tools that sent shivers down my spine. It was then that I noticed the paperwork tossed across the floor, with words like [b]"mutation"[/b], [b]"subject"[/b], and [b]“serum”[/b] scribbled across them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/aca93da85f2d4578f92aa01735f6dd201411bd75.png[/img]

My heart raced as I realized the implications of what I had stumbled upon. This was a facility where [b]human tests[/b] were conducted. What horrors had occurred within these walls? Who were the subjects, and most importantly, was I one of them?[/i]

notes.title: The fauna of this island keeps surprising me
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/08395c065e4d1ad14e85655264d91bcfd3399425.png[/img]

[i]From the first day, I found myself trapped in this strange place, I noticed that some plants carry the valuable Serum that helps me to stay alive. They are not the most sustainable source of this substance, but they provide just enough to get me through the day. 

What I discovered during my most recent expedition to the yet-undiscovered parts of the island shook me to the core. I came across a rather sizeable [b]tubular plant[/b] that seemed very… alive. I didn’t want to risk advancing towards it and kept observing from a distance.

After a short while, a family of [b]Rotten Rabbits[/b] approached the plant as if they wanted to try if it was edible. As soon as they got close enough, the plant exploded, launching its Serum-infused spores into the air. The rabbits fell almost immediately, but I was unsure if they were dead or incapacitated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/bda77b844cc61f630a3b219edc95280b1d9f8f2e.png[/img]

I could swear that with each minute, I spotted more and more of these plants as if they were reproducing rapidly. The truth was they were camouflaged well with the forest undergrowth, so I had to be extra careful with each subsequent step. 

I decided not to go any further and returned to my shelter. I need to make a plan on how to proceed. I must find a way around the plants if the spores are deadly. And even if they are not, they still might accelerate the mutation or, best case scenario, grant me a new ability. So many unknowns, yet I’m in no hurry to find out.

One thing that really makes me lose sleep is these plants must have grown from other seeds or spores, which means there is potentially a [b]much larger plant[/b] somewhere out there. I just hope I won’t cross paths with it.[/i]

I have noticed something strange about the creatures outside – they have become more alert – as if they are waiting for an [b]important event[/b] to happen. The days are becoming shorter and colder, and my longing for home is getting stronger. 

Could this mean it’s [b]that time of the year?[/b] If that’s the case, then to whoever finds this note: I wish you [b]Happy Holidays[/b].[/i]

notes.title: A deadly and silent weapon
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/b850c79b0c8680b885207e56be46caef64c52dfc.gif[/img]

[i][b]Day 25[/b][/i]

[i]Thanks to my multiple excursions, I managed to find some useful scrap. I was never very good with a bow and arrow, but at least it’s a fairly easy-to-craft weapon. I could build my bow by connecting a few pieces of metal, some gears, and a sturdy and flexible string. All I need now is a little bit of practice. Before venturing any further and facing tougher creatures, I should look around the safehouse for smaller, less dangerous prey.[/i]

[i][b]Day 30[/b][/i]

[i]I just had a brilliant idea – or at least it seems like one. If I could place a small container just above the bow handle, I could use it to store different types of Serum and use it to enhance my arrows. I am sure that some varieties of this substance could affect my enemies differently. Maybe this will give me an upper hand against some of the abominations that stand in my way toward freedom.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/7b594831c01296484e422bcac1848356371cd734.png[/img]

[i][b]Day 32[/b][/i]

[i]Yes! I have tested my theory, and the serum-soaked arrows proved to be a great help against a pack of Mist Wolves. The damage I can now deal against those creatures is significantly greater than before. Let’s experiment more with different Serum recipes and see if I can move to another area. This one is becoming very scarce in resources.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/59da16146c0b02f348b739f7137aadb3e8056958.png[/img]

[i][b]Day 17[/b][/i]

[i]I’ve been here long enough to know that I cannot get out of here without harnessing the Serum. Almost every organic being in this land is filled with green fluid, just waiting for me to collect. On one of my recent expeditions, I found a strange blueprint for a contraption that looks like it might help me retrieve the substance from the Rotten Rabbits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/4bab66db980d2058a271d56161ff1f57666ccbec.png[/img]

I can still do it by killing the creatures, but I must traverse further after each hunt to find more colonies. Making this device might help me get more Serum from each animal I bring back. I have the traps already, so catching a live specimen should not be a problem. I must look for parts and try my luck.[/i]

[i][b]Day 23[/b][/i]

[i]I did it! After building the device and several failed attempts, I finally have a sustainable source of Serum. If I could find more blueprints, I would be able to build bigger contraptions and gather the substance from larger animals. This would be my next step to freedom. No time to waste – I need to keep exploring.[/i]

notes.title: A strange feeling
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/6536847d2cbeb65a8e5080ee6a240cf7cdd70d9e.png[/img]

[i]I know that the only way to survive in this treacherous land is to inject myself with a mysterious substance that somehow shields my body from the hazardous environment. But there’s also something else I’m experiencing with each new shot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/0780cba5c47414401cde228d3fb2bd08fbcdc6e6.png[/img]

The [b]Serum[/b] alters how my body reacts depending on how I mix the ingredients. I still haven’t figured out exactly how this works, but once, I felt a strange increase in my mobility after injecting myself with Serum mixed with a substance that came from the [b]Rotten Rabbit[/b]. Or maybe that was just the adrenaline?

I wonder if I can use that to my [b]advantage[/b] and increase my chances of ever leaving this cursed place. I need to do some more testing before I am completely sure, but I have a strange feeling that I’m on the right track. The only way to find out is to hunt some more dangerous creatures and create a new mixture. This better be worth the risk![/i]
